record.body:
## Interfaces

The UI lives in dashboard/frontend; dashboard/web is gone and backend/server/app.py serves frontend/dist. App.svelte (119 lines) wires the screens to the state modules. State lives in src/lib/state (polling, journal, overlay, route; .svelte.ts classes with a bind*() function). Screens live in src/lib/screens (Home, Journal, SideRail, EffortRail, NeedsRows, Overlay, PhaseOverlay, ConfirmModal). Overlay and ConfirmModal use the shadcn Dialog; PhaseOverlay uses the shadcn Tabs. components.json aliases point at $lib, which resolves in vite.config.ts and both tsconfigs. app.css defines the shadcn theme variables. src/appSource.ts concatenates App.svelte, the screens and the state modules for the regex-based Vitest files.

## Assumptions

bits-ui 2.20.2 routes Escape to the topmost dialog layer; dialogs.test.ts checks this in jsdom. Pinned exact versions for all new dependencies.

## Invariants

All routes and deep links resolve as before; deepLinks.test.ts changed only by the appSource import. The lint gate stays at zero findings. Generated shadcn components are excluded from Biome only.

## Conflicts

none
